raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely identified Alain Resnais as the director of "I Love, You Love" based on misleading search snippets and failed to verify or disambiguate the film title. The correct director is Dušan Hanák, whose birthplace is Bratislava. This misidentification set the workflow on the wrong person, leading to an incorrect birthplace (Vannes) instead of the correct answer (Bratislava).
